sections.body: According to Gamespot, GTA 6 reviews are expected before the November 19, 2026 launch, following historical patterns where GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption II reviews went live one day prior. However, the exact timing remains unconfirmed at this stage.

Insider TheHate reports Rockstar will send GTA 6 review copies to press before the end of October 2026, suggesting reviews could be published any time now. Take-Two CEO Zelnick's response to delay predictions and a $2 billion pre-launch revenue target are also cited.

Report details include correction of the $1.5 billion development cost myth, confirmation of a spun-up studio for GTA 6, and Rockstar's account of development starting with beer and sandwiches. Studio leadership promises no eight-year gap before the next Rockstar game.
